craft_notes: Sthāyin: utkrānti unit 31. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: In tattva, wherever, anywhere, he should join the person in sequence:
samayin or putraka should read this vidyā, thus.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tattve vā yatra kutrāpi yojayetpudgalaṃ kramāt samayī putrako vāpi paṭhedvidyāmimāṃ tathā
